integrity: The proof is analytic: exact sine-mode formulas are reduced to scalar inequalities proved by alternating-series bounds, monotonicity, and exact polynomial factorizations. Finite enumeration is supplementary only. The stored day-resolved public-source anchor is 2005-07-18; an older relevant 2004 article was found only with month-level public timing.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the uniform one-dimensional Dirichlet \(P_1\) problem and modes \(k\le\lfloor N/2\rfloor\). No claim is made for higher modes, nonuniform meshes, variable coefficients, higher dimensions, or unstructured discretizations. Earlier close superaccurate consistent-versus-lumped literature remains a terminology and implication risk. The older Hu–Huang–Shen source is month-resolved in accessible publication metadata, so no publication day was invented.
title: Arithmetic–geometric bracketing of uniform linear-FEM Laplace eigenvalues
